_meta.description: Transparent inputs for Paper E AI-effectiveness threshold model. Replaces the omnibus 'HR approx 0.91 / five-fold' claim, which is absent from the pipeline (see RECONCILIATION_phase2.md). Structural-closure uncertainty is propagated from Paper F PSA draws.
_meta.status_legend: verified = checked this build; provisional = to be finalized in literature-review + citation-management

gap.source: CDC WONDER by CDC SVI quartile; county_disparity_results.csv

ai_reach.source: assumption: reachable chronic-disease-management-eligible fraction of high-vuln (SVI Q4) population; anchored to digital-health uptake gradients (Rodriguez 2020 JAMA) and chronic-disease prevalence
ai_reach.note: Key sensitivity parameter. Universal reach (1.0) reported as an explicit upper-bound scenario to expose the omnibus's implicit assumption.

structural_closure_source: rederived_F_psa_draws.npy (Paper F portfolio PSA); falls back to fixed scenarios if absent

benchmarks.note: Required AI HR is compared to demonstrated effect sizes; source Kangovi 2018/2020 and this study's AI meta-analysis (null).
